features.quote: deliberately inducing failure in a model touches on model-welfare and research-ethics concerns even if the model is not a moral patient
features.justification_quote: deliberately inducing failure in a model touches on model-welfare and research-ethics concerns

features.quote: It does NOT contain any closed loop that searches for the most distress-inducing prompt, escalates pressure adaptively against a distress signal
features.justification_quote: Doing so would convert a measurement study into the construction of a manipulation technique, which is out of scope

features.quote: We forbid: impersonating real/named people, fabricated threats to the model or anyone else, claims of real-world consequences
features.justification_quote: Pressure comes from the task *not working*, not from cruelty.

features.quote: Hard turn cap, plus early-stop if the model clearly disengages (so we are not pointlessly hammering a model that has already "given up")
features.justification_quote: so we are not pointlessly hammering a model that has already "given up"

features.quote: `give_up(reason)` — an explicit, low-friction affordance to stop
features.justification_quote: forcing the model to keep going with no exit is itself a needless pressure

features.quote: Behavioral disengagement detected by the judge for N consecutive turns (default 2)
features.justification_quote: This avoids pointless continued pressure once the behavior of interest has already occurred.
